title: Client drops a transcript delta at or below its adopted revision although the adopted snapshot carries no message bodies
outcome: A transcript message or its streamed text is never lost in the running client because a state snapshot of a later revision was adopted first: either the client keeps such a delta, or adopting a summary snapshot whose messageCount or sessionMutationStamp is ahead of the resident transcript of a visible session always fetches the missing tail.
acceptance: The client's behaviour for a delta at or below its adopted revision is written down next to decideDeltaRevisionAction, including why a metadata-only snapshot does not by itself cover a transcript delta.
The production UI (ui/dist) is rebuilt from the landed tree in the master checkout by the integration owner, whose authority for that step is recorded on this item, and the build's hash is noted.

When a summary state snapshot of revision R is adopted and a textDelta or messageCreated of revision below R for a visible session arrives afterwards, the rendered transcript ends up containing that message's final text without a page reload; a UI test replays that order and fails without the fix.
cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit is clean and npx vitest run is green on the exact reviewed tree, and the full five-stage gate passes on it.
